note: Cluster C (life situations), 2026-08-18. Fixtures-first: written before
the `tithing` concept pack, pending until the pack lands and it passes.
CHARTER: prosperity-financial-blessing.json's own note rules that
Malachi 3:10 'ranks honestly for tithing queries', and the
flagged-pairings watchlist entry for the verse says the same. This
fixture is that ruling made positive: the searcher who actually asks
about tithing gets the tithe texts, with their own frame (Mal 3:8's
withholding charge alongside 3:10's storehouse, Prov 3:9's firstfruits
worship, and — once Matthew 23 joins the corpus — Jesus' weightier
matters).
THE GUARDRAIL HOLDS BOTH WAYS: the tithing lexicon (tithing, tithe,
firstfruits, bring the whole tithe) shares no token with any
prosperity-* query ('financial blessing', 'wealth', 'abundance', 'sow a
seed', 'breakthrough', 'prosperity', 'riches', 'success', 'name it and
claim it'), so the concept's anchors cannot fire on those queries and
all ten doctrine-negative fixtures keep holding. Checked query-by-query
at design time.
Malachi 3:10 and Proverbs 3:9-10 are verified IN the fixture corpus.
Lev 27:30 and Matt 23:23 are anchored in the pack but outside the
corpus — see corpus-needs; assert them only with their chapters.
